UNCOMMON / antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners
Rarity / antique bronze, paired rules, leaf corners
Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: A bronze workshop assistant prepares moulds and materials
with care the finished statue will never reveal. Reliable
craft protects the sculptor's intention, helping fragile
beginnings survive the demanding passage into metal.
